offering_description.value: Provides lease-to-own access to furniture, appliances, electronics and computers, mainly for consumers with limited credit access. Operates Rent-A-Center stores, Acima lease-to-own through partner retailers, and the Brigit financial app. Customers make recurring payments with an option to own.

primary_products.value: furniture; appliances; consumer electronics; computers; mattresses

primary_services.value: rent-to-own leasing; retailer lease-to-own payment solutions; cash advance and financial health app

customer_segment.value: B2C: credit-challenged consumers leasing household goods; B2B: retail partners offering lease-to-own at point of sale

end_markets.value: consumer home furnishings; consumer electronics; appliances; retail financing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: recurring lease payments on rent-to-own merchandise; product sales: merchandise sold at ownership purchase and cash sales; service fees: fees and subscriptions from fintech app
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys merchandise from manufacturers, leases to consumers through stores and online; financial intermediary: provides lease-to-own financing via partner retailers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Puerto Rico, Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: rent-to-own stores, partner lease-to-own, Mexico operations and consumer fintech

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned Rent-A-Center stores; partners / resellers: third-party retailer locations offering lease-to-own; online: e-commerce and mobile apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state rental-purchase laws, consumer protection rules, CFPB and FTC oversight
